roleTitle: Travel Labor and Delivery Registered Nurse (RN)

description:

Your expertise will be crucial in identifying changes in patient status and responding effectively to critical situations.

This is a contract position with an attractive hourly rate, scheduled to begin on July 13, 2026. Join a team committed to patient-centered care and professional growth.

Current BLS and ACLS certifications.
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent experience in Cardiac Telemetry or a similar acute care setting.
Ability to commit to PM shifts for the duration of the contract.
